title: Arawakan languages - Wikipedia
text: Arawakan, also known as Maipurean, is a language family spoken amongst various Indigenous peoples in South America. Branches migrated to Central America and the Greater Antilles and Lesser Antilles in the Caribbean and the Atlantic, including what is now the Bahamas.

title: Ashéninka, Perené | Ethnologue Free
text: Perené Ashéninka is an endangered indigenous language of Peru. It belongs to the Maipurean language family. The language is used as a first language by all adults in the ethnic community, but not all young people.
